dockerode>uuid.reason: dockerode pins uuid@3 which ships a weak RNG on some platforms; 11.x uses crypto.randomUUID
dockerode>uuid.remove_when: dockerode bumps its own uuid dep to >=11

testcontainers>tmp.reason: testcontainers@10 depends on tmp@0.2.x; older patch has predictable temp-file paths (local dev/CI only, not production)

@grpc/grpc-js.reason: Fixes remote memory exhaustion via large metadata headers

esbuild.reason: Fixes development-server CORS bypass that allows cross-origin reads of local files

postcss.reason: Fixes ReDoS via crafted CSS input in the parser
postcss.remove_when: tailwindcss / other direct consumers adopt postcss >=8.5.10

js-yaml.reason: Prototype pollution via __proto__ key in YAML documents
js-yaml.remove_when: transitive consumers (jest-circus, cosmiconfig, etc.) adopt js-yaml >=4.2.0

@babel/core.reason: Arbitrary code execution via crafted plugin-transform-runtime config
@babel/core.remove_when: babel ecosystem aligns on >=7.29.6 in its own deps

testcontainers>undici.reason: undici header smuggling / SSRF (same CVE-2025-22150 family, testcontainers pins an older undici major)

jsdom>ws.reason: Unchecked header size causes unbounded memory allocation (DoS)
